stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class); no readable Common Data Set was found on the Plymouth State site. College Navigator fall 2024 shows 6,878 applicants and 88% admitted. IPEDS reports no SAT/ACT percentiles for this school, and no GPA, international-applicant or residency splits. Undergraduate enrollment (3,182) and the 15:1 student-faculty ratio are from College Navigator, fall 2024.
